Interface WaitingLine<T>

Type Parameters:
T - type of entries
All Superinterfaces:
Iterable<T>, components.standard.Standard<WaitingLine<T>>, WaitingLineKernel<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
WaitingLine1, WaitingLineSecondary
public interface WaitingLine<T> extends WaitingLineKernel<T>
A waiting line with inspection, concatenation, and priority operations.

Baowen Liu

  • Method Details

    • front

      T front()
      Reports the first entry without changing the line.
      Returns:
      the first entry
      Requires:
      this is not empty
      Ensures:
      <front> is a prefix of this
      Aliases:
      reference returned by front

    • append

      void append(WaitingLine<T> q)
      Moves every entry of q to the back of this line, in order.
      Parameters:
      q - source line
      Requires:
      q != null and q != this and no entry in q is in this
      Ensures:
      this = #this * #q
      Updates:
      this
      Clears:
      q

    • pos

      int pos(T x)
      Reports an entry's zero-based position without changing the line.
      Parameters:
      x - entry to locate
      Returns:
      the position of x, with zero denoting the front
      Requires:
      x != null and x is in this
      Ensures:
      this[pos] = x

    • insertAtFront

      void insertAtFront(T x)
      Inserts a new entry at the front, preserving the existing order.
      Parameters:
      x - entry to add
      Requires:
      x != null and x is not in this
      Ensures:
      this = <x> * #this
      Updates:
      this
      Aliases:
      reference x

    • moveToFront

      void moveToFront(T x)
      Moves an existing entry to the front, preserving the others' order.
      Parameters:
      x - entry to prioritize
      Requires:
      x != null and x is in this
      Ensures:
      there exist strings a, b such that #this = a * <x> * b and this = <x> * a * b
      Updates:
      this
